title: Multi-crate Cargo workspace import resolution — cross-crate edges never resolve
description:
normalize_to_crate_segments (src/rust_imports.rs:71) only recognizes crate::/self::/super:: and THE root Cargo.toml's [package] name. In a multi-crate workspace (e.g. adityas/backend: server + report + quiver-client), `use report::render` from server/ returns None → the import stays unresolved → no edge → forbidden_dep "server/** -> report/**" and boundary constraints between workspace crates NEVER fire. Silently inert, same failure class as max_fan_in (sutra/simple-additions/8). Also file_to_module_segments assumes paths start with "src/", which is false for crate-subdir layouts ("server/src/main.rs"), so super::/self:: resolution inside member crates is likely wrong too.

Found during sutra/needs-designing/14 (2026-06-11). Interim mitigation (documented in README + vidhi-sutra SKILL.md): sibling-crate imports classify as EXTERNAL, so forbidden_external/confined_external express crate-to-crate seams, including via the Cargo.toml path-dependency signal.

Design questions: parse [workspace.members] and each member's [package] name → per-crate module roots; resolution maps <member_name>::path → <member_dir>/src/path; file_to_module_segments needs crate-root-relative semantics. Decide whether resolved cross-crate edges should then make external-kind classification of siblings disappear (it should — and seed rules written with the external-kind workaround would need migrating to forbidden_dep).
implementation_plan: Parse [workspace.members] + member Cargo.toml names → WorkspaceLayout. normalize_to_crate_segments recognizes sibling crate prefixes and resolves to target crate's src dir. file_to_module_segments/resolve_segments parameterized by src_prefix. external_crate_of_import excludes workspace members. Hard error if forbidden_external/confined_external targets a workspace member.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — verdict: needs-attention

1. [high] Workspace crate detection ignores [lib].name (src/rust_imports.rs:112-116)
   read_workspace_member records only [package].name normalized with hyphens→underscores. When [lib].name differs from package name, cross-crate imports using the lib name won't resolve. Fix: parse [lib].name, fall back to normalized [package].name.

2. [high] Guard converts new hard error into allow (src/guard.rs:433-466)
   validate_no_external_targeting_members is called in evaluate_dd/evaluate_raw but the guard-facing wrappers may discard errors via unwrap_or_default(). Also EvalScope::Edges doesn't run validation before checking externals. Fix: propagate errors through guard path, run validation for all eval scopes.
